description: List the user's Brand Voices (id, name).

description.name: list_offer_briefs
description.description: List the user's Offer Briefs (id, name).

description.name: list_analyzed_pages
description.description: List Facebook pages the user analyzed (competitor, inspiration or brand_campaigns), with status and ad counts.

description.name: search_ads_library
description.description: Search the user's own Ads Library (ads collected by their searches) and this week's Top Ads by brand, niche, sector or copy. Returns ad ids usable with analyze_ad and run_ad_copilot.

description.name: get_market_creators_data
description.description: Aggregated stats of the creators/competitors the user monitors.

description.name: get_top_performing_ads
description.description: Top performing (longest running) ads of the monitored creators.

description.name: get_active_ads_copy
description.description: Copy (body, caption, CTA) of currently active ads of the monitored creators.

description.name: get_saved_ads
description.description: The user's swipe file, optionally filtered by competitor name.

description.name: get_strategic_avatar
description.description: Avatar research of a project (from list_projects): pain matrix, core wound, desire chain, objections, triggers, language and strategic synthesis.

description.name: get_competitor_active_ads
description.description: Active ads of a competitor the user has analyzed with Competitor Spy.

description.name: get_creative_analysis
description.description: Saved AI analysis of an ad (awareness, hooks, mechanism, triggers, landing page coherence), if analyze_ad was run on it.

description.name: get_job_status
description.description: Status and results of a background job started by an action tool.

description.name: run_competitor_spy
description.description: Scrape and analyze all ads of a competitor's Facebook page (uses 1 Competitor Spy credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_inspiration_search
description.description: Scrape and analyze a page outside the user's niche for inspiration (uses 1 Inspiration Search credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_brand_campaign_analysis
description.description: Scrape and analyze the user's own brand Meta campaigns page (uses 1 Brand Campaigns credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_ad_copilot
description.description: Adapt a library ad into 3 copy variants for the user's Avatar, Offer Brief and Brand Voice (uses 1 Ad Copilot credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: analyze_ad
description.description: Ads Intelligence: full AI analysis of one ad (emotional levers, biases, landing page coherence). Uses 1 Ads Intelligence credit. Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_persuasion_analysis
description.description: Persuasion analysis of an ad before launch: present and missing cognitive biases (uses 1 Persuasion Analysis credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_sales_psychology
description.description: Sales Psychology report for a project's Avatar + an Offer Brief (uses 1 Sales Psychology credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: create_brand_voice
description.description: Create and save a Brand Voice from a public URL or a text (uses 1 Brand Voice credit, ~1 minute).

description.name: create_offer_brief
description.description: Create and save an Offer Brief from a public sales page URL or a text (uses 1 Offer Brief credit, ~1 minute).

description.name: run_magic_tool
description.description: Summarize, translate or extract contacts/links from a text (Magic Tools). Summaries and extractions are in the language of the text; translations go to `language` (default Italiano).
